name: Kvasir-SEG: Gastrointestinal Polyp Segmentation Dataset
description: Kvasir-SEG is an open-access medical image segmentation dataset consisting of 1,000 gastrointestinal polyp images collected during real colonoscopy procedures at Vestre Viken Health Trust in Norway. Each image is paired with a verified pixel-level ground truth binary segmentation mask and bounding box verified by experienced gastroenterologists.
